:::{#hero-heading}

Mattia Piazza designs algorithms that push vehicles to their limits — from MotoGP motorcycles to autonomous cars — using optimal control and real-time motion planning. He is a PhD researcher at the University of Trento, currently working on [FBGA](https://github.com/DRIVEWISE/FBGA), a forward-backward method for time-optimal velocity planning under generic acceleration constraints. Off the clock, he trades the desk for a mountain.

:::
